prTitle: feat: add calendar cache status and actions (#22532)
head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793

tps.bug: After deleting the calendar cache, CredentialActionsDropdown does not invalidate the connectedCalendars query, so where no parent refetch callback is passed the stale cache status and delete action remain visible.
tps.evidenciaOpus: CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx:42-50 deleteCacheMutation only calls onSuccess?.() and never invalidates viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars, unlike disconnectMutation (:61-64). The settings page passes an onChanged that invalidates, but EventAdvancedTab renders SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper without onChanged, so there the deleted cache status stays visible.
tps.evidenciaAstra: packages/features/apps/components/CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx:43 only invokes the optional callback after deletion. Although CalendarListContainer.tsx:87 supplies invalidation, packages/features/eventtypes/components/tabs/advanced/EventAdvancedTab.tsx:372 mounts the wrapper without that callback, leaving its cache status stale after deletion.

tps.bug: Date is formatted with hardcoded 'en-US' locale instead of using the user's locale from useLocale, which can lead to incorrect date representation for users in different locales.
tps.evidenciaOpus: CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx:89-92 formats cacheUpdatedAt with new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", ...) while the label is translated via t() from useLocale, so non-US users see US date order.
tps.evidenciaAstra: packages/features/apps/components/CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx:89 explicitly formats the timestamp using en-US while translating the surrounding message at line 88. The active locale is available through packages/lib/hooks/useLocale.ts:58, but is ignored, producing incorrect localization for other locales.

tps.bug: logic: macOS-specific sed syntax with empty string after -i flag will fail on Linux systems
tps.evidenciaOpus: scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh:68 uses sed -i '' -E ..., the BSD/macOS form; GNU sed treats '' as the script and fails, so on Linux GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL is not updated while the script still prints that it was.
tps.evidenciaAstra: scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh:68 uses BSD-specific sed -i '' syntax, which fails under GNU sed when replacing an existing GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL. The script does not check the command result and prints the success message at line 73 despite leaving the old URL unchanged.

tps.bug: Throwing a generic Error for authentication failures results in a 500 response in tRPC. Instead, it should return a structured TRPCError with an appropriate code, such as FORBIDDEN, to accurately reflect the error type.
tps.evidenciaOpus: deleteCache.handler.ts:24-26 throws new Error("Credential not found or access denied"), which tRPC maps to INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (500) instead of a TRPCError with NOT_FOUND/FORBIDDEN.
tps.evidenciaAstra: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/calendars/deleteCache.handler.ts:17 checks credential ownership and throws a generic Error at line 25 when that check fails. This authorization failure becomes an internal-server error, and packages/trpc/server/errorFormatter.ts:38 preserves that classification instead of returning an appropriate access-denied or not-found code.
